text:
leah: Heads up — noticed cert-rotation failing for APAC edge proxies starting ~2026-03-20T08:05Z. TLS handshake errors spiking, and rotator logs show KMS decrypt failures: `AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to use key`.

samir: Hmm — I think the RBAC change from yesterday might have removed the `rotator` service account binding to the kms:Decrypt grant. Investigating.

maya: Can you paste the relevant log snippet?

leah: Sure — from `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/cert-rotator --tail 200`:
```
2026-03-20T08:04:57Z ERROR cert-rotator main.go:312 KMS decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:111222333:key/abcd-ef01
	status=403 request_id=xyz-123
```

kevin: Confirming on the audit side — CloudTrail/Cloud Audit shows the rotator SA has zero `Decrypt` attempts for yesterday->today in ap-southeast-1. Looks like binding never existed for that region after the IAM rollout.

samir: I see the PR (infra/iam#905) — it removed a legacy grant and added a narrower one, but missed the regional grant for `rotator@infra`. That PR passed CI but didn't include the kms grant check.

leah: Quick repro commands I ran: `kubectl -n infra exec -it deploy/cert-rotator -- sh -c "\/opt\/bin\/kms-unseal --key arn:aws:kms:..."` returns the same AccessDenied.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback triggered for infra/iam#905 by @samir. Automated rollback started on `infra-iam` at 2026-03-20T08:10Z.

samir: Rolling back the RBAC change now to restore `kms:Decrypt` for `rotator@infra` in ap-southeast-1. Patch will add explicit grant and a test.

maya: Temporary mitigation idea — enable fallback lookup to the local shadow keystore on proxies so TLS handshakes can continue while KMS access is fixed. Also create a short-lived cert (signed by our internal CA) to serve until rotation stabilizes.

kevin: Agreed. Also we should add an alert rule to detect sudden drop in `kms:Decrypt` calls from known rotation SAs and a distinct alert for `AccessDenied` spikes. That would catch this earlier.

leah: I'm updating the runbook: /runbooks/cert-rotation -> added step to check IAM grants, cloud audit, and fallback path. Creating incident now.

security-oncall: Please file an incident with timeline + add audit export for the timeframe. We need KMS logs, IAM policy diffs (PR link), and the proxy TLS error samples for the postmortem. Also add `who` for the RBAC PR approvals.

leah: Created INC-2026-0421 and added logs + PR link (infra/iam#905). Assigning to eng-infra & eng-security. ETA for patch + verify ~25m.

samir: Patch applied at 2026-03-20T08:28Z — re-granted `kms:Decrypt` for `rotator@infra` in ap-southeast-1. Requeued rotation job.

infra-bot: rotator: rotation job 2026-03-20T08:30 succeeded: cert published to proxy-configs, proxies reloaded.

kevin: Follow-ups (action items):
- Add CI check: infra/ci -> verify `iam diff` includes `kms:Decrypt` when key rotations or role refactors touch rotator service accounts.
- Add regional IAM binding tests for ap-southeast-1 in our infra test matrix.
- Add alert: `KMSDecryptRate_drop` and `KMSAccessDenied_spike`.
- TLS hardening: ensure ingress proxies enforce TLS1.3 + disable legacy ciphers. Example nginx snippets added to infra/security-configs:```
ssl_protocols TLSv1.3;
ssl_ciphers TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256;
ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;
```

maya: I'll pick up the CI gating and the postmortem write-up. tagging @eng-security and @eng-infra.

leah: Verified: proxies in ap-southeast-1 show handshake success rates back to normal, and audit logs show recent `kms:Decrypt` calls from rotator. Closing incident when postmortem done.

samir: Will add a small automation to scan PRs that touch IAM for missing kms grants.

maya: Postmortem TODOs: timeline, root cause (RBAC PR missed regional grant), detection gap (no alert for KMS AccessDenied), mitigations (CI check, fallback keystore, alerting, TLS policy validation), owners + ETA.

leah: Thanks all. Great cross-team response. :white_check_mark:
